input: Source a second-hand road bike for commuting

gold.taskTitle: Source a Second-Hand Road Bike for Commuting
gold.taskDescription: Find and purchase a used road bike suitable for daily commuting.

questions.title: What is your total budget for the bike?
questions.description: Understanding the maximum spend helps filter realistic options.

questions.title: How long is your typical daily commute distance?
questions.description: Commute length influences the type and spec of bike needed.

questions.title: What is your approximate height or current frame size?
questions.description: Frame sizing is critical for fit and comfort on a road bike.

questions.title: Do you prefer buying locally in person or online?
questions.description: Determines which platforms and sourcing channels to prioritise.

questions.title: Are there specific brands or components you want?
questions.description: Brand or groupset preferences narrow down the search criteria.

questions.title: What terrain and road conditions will you be riding on?
questions.description: Road quality and route type affect tyre and geometry requirements.

questions.title: How soon do you need the bike ready to ride?
questions.description: The timeline affects whether refurbishment or immediate use is the priority.
